MONETARY POLICY COMMITTEE

The SARB’s Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) conducts monetary policy within a flexible inflation-targeting framework
 

The MPC consists of up to seven members from the SARB: the Governor, the three deputy governors and selected senior officials appointed by the Governor. The Governor chairs the MPC meetings.

 

Mr E L (Lesetja) Kganyago
Governor

Dr R (Rashad) Cassim
Deputy Governor

Ms Nomfundo (Fundi) Tshazibana
Deputy Governor and CEO of the Prudential Authority

Dr M (Mampho) Modise
Deputy Governor

Dr David Fowkes
Adviser to the Governors

Dr Konstantin Makrelov
Chief Economist

Click here for the Monetary Policy Committee members' biographies.

 

 
MPC statements


Statements on the SARB’s monetary policy stance are released after each MPC meeting.
